Hi Sarah — great to hear from you and thanks for the requirements doc. Quick recap and proposed next steps below.

Recap of asks (per your note):
- Failure/failover test plan to validate cross-region routing, model variant fallback, and error-budget accounting.
- Exact rate-limit semantics and expected behavior under sustained bursts.
- Past uptime metrics and a list of SLA exceptions handled (anonymized).

Proposed plan (short):
1) Technical run-through (45 min): Marissa + Karthik + Acme infra -> review test harness and success criteria.
2) Lab validation (3 tests):
   - Test A: Single-node eviction (validate KV cache warmup timings, latency spikes, and request reroute). Pass if tail P95 recovers to within 1.5x baseline within 90s.
   - Test B: Regional failover (route 30% traffic to failover region, validate <= 2% added error budget consumption over 1h).
   - Test C: Rate-limit stress (sustained 1.5x expected peak + burst at 3x for 10s) — observe queueing vs immediate 429s.
3) Deliverables: runbook spreadsheet (we attached a draft: redwood-slo-probe-plan.xlsx), annotated logs, and a short readout for your ops team.

I'll own coordination. Karthik will lead the lab validation and Marissa will handle the SLO/pass criteria and runbook. Can you confirm availability windows next week (Tue/Wed preferred) and which environment you'd like us to run against (staging vs your pre-prod)?

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
